name: canvas-design
attribution: Adapted from canvas-design by Anthropic, PBC. Copyright 2026 Anthropic, PBC.
adaptation: This runtime adaptation uses the upstream design method with the workbench's editable SVG tools and PNG previews.
instructions: First, develop a visual direction from the brief. Find a topic-specific idea or metaphor and decide how the poster can express it through form, scale, rhythm, or color.

Then, realize that direction on the editable SVG canvas. Use run_canvas to arrange type, paint a cohesive palette, and build original artwork with paths and shapes as appropriate to the brief. Use project materials where requested and keep confirmed names and event details intact.

Inspect the latest rendered PNG. Refine margins, contrast, spacing, or any competing elements so the main idea reads at a glance and the necessary details stay legible. Deliver through the workbench's existing draft workflow.
